text_block_list.text:
It was finally time to take on the 
February Stakes. Normally, an Umamusume 
would be nervous before a race, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, it was crazy out there! There 
were like twice as many people as last 
time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there's some kind of fun event 
going on today?
choice_data_list: I think there's a GⅠ race...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Nice~ That's such a cool name~. Now I'm 
really curious!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
When the race is over, let's go watch a G1 
together!
choice_data_list: ...First, go give it your all in the race!
...First, good luck out there in the race!
